quickSummary: Centrioles and basal bodies display a 9+0 pattern of 9 peripheral microtubule triplets (A, B, C tubules) connected to a central protein hub by radial spokes in a cartwheel structure (central singlets absent). Cilia and flagella display a 9+2 axoneme pattern (9 peripheral doublets linked by nexin and radial spokes surrounding 2 central singlets enclosed in a sheath). Ciliary bending is powered by ATP hydrolysis by inner and outer dynein arms.

conceptBreakdown.content: Centrosomes and cilia/flagella represent specialized microtubule-organizing centers and locomotory organelles.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 8.1 Centrosome & Centriole (9+0 Cartwheel Architecture)
conceptBreakdown.title: 8.1 Centrosome & Centriole (9+0 Cartwheel Architecture)
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
CENTRIOLE CARTWHEEL CROSS-SECTION
                         
                            [ A-B-C Triplet ] ── (Nexin Link) ──► [ A-B-C Triplet ]
                                   │
                             (Radial Spoke)
                                   │
                                   ▼
                           [ Central HUB ] (No central microtubules)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Centrosome**: Animal organelle consisting of two perpendicular ($90^\circ$) cylindrical **Centrioles** embedded in amorphous Pericentriolar Material (PCM).
• **Centriole Microanatomy (9+0 Triplet Pattern)**:
  - Composed of 9 evenly spaced peripheral triplets (A, B, C tubules) inclined at an angle. Central singlet microtubules are **ABSENT** ($9+0$).
  - The complete A-tubule (13 protofilaments) shares walls with incomplete B and C tubules (10 protofilaments each).
  - **Cartwheel Structure**: A central proteinaceous **Hub** connects via 9 **Radial Spokes** to the A-tubules of peripheral triplets. Adjacent triplets are linked by A-C nexin bridges.
  - **Function**: Forms the **Basal Bodies (Blepharoplasts)** of cilia/flagella and nucleates the mitotic spindle in animal cells.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 8.2 Cilia & Flagella (9+2 Axoneme Architecture)
conceptBreakdown.title: 8.2 Cilia & Flagella (9+2 Axoneme Architecture)
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
CILIA / FLAGELLA AXONEME DIAGRAM
                       
                                 [ Plasma Membrane ]
                                         │
                             ┌──────────────────────┐
                             │ Outer Dynein Arm     │
                             │ Inner Dynein Arm     │
                             └──────────┬───────────┘
                                        │
                     (B-tubule) O O (A-tubule) <-- Peripheral Doublet (9 Pairs)
                                \   /
                                 \ / ──► Nexin Interdoublet Link
                                  │
                             Radial Spoke
                                  │
                                  ▼
                           Central Sheath
                             ( O   O ) <-- 2 Central Singlet Microtubules
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Axoneme Components**:
  - **9 Peripheral Doublets**: Each doublet consists of an A-tubule and B-tubule.
  - **2 Central Singlet Microtubules**: Enclosed within a protective proteinaceous **Central Sheath**.
  - **Radial Spokes**: Connect peripheral doublets to the central sheath.
  - **Nexin Links**: Elastic protein bridges connecting adjacent doublets.
• **Ciliary Dynein ATPase Mechanism**: Outer and inner **Dynein Arms** projecting from the A-tubule hydrolyze ATP to walk along the adjacent B-tubule. Because interdoublet sliding is constrained by nexin links, the generated shear force is converted into synchronized ciliary bending/beating.
